name: blindfold
description: Give coding agents your databases, APIs, and env vars without the values landing in the transcript. The agent loads a credential into the environment of the command it runs, and never sees the value.

interface.shortDescription: Use your credentials without exposing them
interface.longDescription: Stores credentials as named bundles of environment variables. Codex can see what exists and load one into the environment of the command it is about to run with blindfold exec <name> -- <command>, so it gets the result without the value entering the conversation or the session transcript.
defaultPrompt: What credentials do I have access to?
Show me the schema of the candidates table.
Check how many documents are in the logs index.
